<thought>The mass spectrum shows a protonated molecular ion at m/z 114.06808. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 113.0608 Da. The isotopic pattern (M+1 ≈ 6.7 %) corresponds to about six carbon atoms (≈ 6 × 1.1 %). A formula with six carbons that matches the exact mass is C₆H₉O₂ (exact neutral mass 113.060255 Da, within a few ppm of the observed value). This fits both the mass and the isotopic distribution.</thought>
<final_answer>C6H9O2</final_answer>
